intro:
The three compared statements in `Challenge.lean` rest on the Mathlib definitions below, except sections 17–24, which no compared statement uses (see the end of this paragraph). The remaining vocabulary is standard Mathlib and is not quoted: `RingHom` (`K →+* ℂ`), the norm on `ℂ`, `Finset.sum`, `Module.finrank`, `integralClosure`, `IsIntegral`, `Polynomial.map`, `Polynomial.roots`, `Int.castRingHom`, `⊤` of intermediate fields, `AdjoinRoot` and the ring and field structures (and, for the uncompared theorems, `Complex.re`, `star`, `Matrix.of`, `Pi.single` and `⊔` of intermediate fields). Each excerpt is copied verbatim from Mathlib at the pinned revision `065356127b1dc0016f66b7283ce0ce2c4055aa55` (the revision required in `lakefile.toml` and recorded in `lake-manifest.json`), with its file path, line numbers and a permalink; every excerpt was byte-compared against `raw.githubusercontent.com` at that revision when this file was generated by `scripts/gen_mathlib_definitions.py` from `scripts/mathlib_definitions_spec.json`. Mathlib is released under the Apache 2.0 license; copyright of these excerpts remains with the Mathlib authors named in each file's header. Sections 5, 9, 12 and 25 quote theorems, not definitions. Sections 17–24 (`IntermediateField.LinearDisjoint` and the two definitions behind it, `Matrix.kroneckerMap`, `⊗ₖ`, `Matrix.diagonal`, `dotProduct`, `Matrix.mulVec`) are used by no compared statement: they are kept for the uncompared Gram identity `HeightT2.t2Gram_compositum` and the uncompared coordinate bound `HeightT2.coord_sq_le_sum_norm_sq`, whose statements use them.

The entry's own definitions are stated in `Challenge.lean` itself: the field `L`, its elements `ρ` and `Q` and the rest of the definition block of the author's entry PALOMAR-2026-10-21-000012 between the lines `-- BEGIN SHARED DEFINITIONS` and `-- END SHARED DEFINITIONS` (the same text as `HermiteCompositum/Defs.lean`), and `HeightT2.IsPerronNumber` between `-- BEGIN HEIGHT DEFINITIONS` and `-- END HEIGHT DEFINITIONS` (the same text as in `HeightT2/Defs.lean`). The definitions `HeightT2.t2Gram` and `HeightT2.t2GramRe` of the uncompared theorems are in `HeightT2/Defs.lean` and `DefinitionAudit.lean`, not in `Challenge.lean`. They are described in the Challenge's opening docstring.

The file `DefinitionAudit.lean` is built with the package (a default target) and checks, as theorems, the facts about these definitions that the informal account relies on. It is not part of the compared set and imports Mathlib only. Its theorems use only the axioms `propext`, `Classical.choice` and `Quot.sound` (one uses `propext` and `Quot.sound` only; see `BUILD.txt`).

sections.title: `Height.AdmissibleAbsValues`: the family of absolute values behind the height
sections.comment: A field with this structure carries a multiset of archimedean absolute values (with multiplicity) and a set of nonarchimedean ones satisfying the product formula. For number fields Mathlib's instance is section 4.

sections.title: `Height.mulHeight₁`: the multiplicative height
sections.comment: Used in statement 1 (and in the uncompared equality case `HeightT2.sum_norm_sq_eq_mulHeight₁_sq_add_iff`). It is the height relative to the field: no root of the degree is taken. Kernel-checked normalization: `DefinitionAudit.mulHeight₁_two` (`mulHeight₁ (2 : K) = 2 ^ [K:ℚ]`), `DefinitionAudit.mulHeight₁_half_rat` (the finite places count), `DefinitionAudit.mulHeight₁_zero_eq`, `DefinitionAudit.mulHeight₁_one_eq`.

sections.title: The number-field instance of `Height.AdmissibleAbsValues`
sections.comment: The archimedean absolute values are the infinite places, each repeated `mult` times; the nonarchimedean ones are the finite places.

sections.title: `NumberField.mulHeight₁_eq` (a theorem): the height as a product over places
sections.comment: Mathlib's statement of the familiar form. Restated as `DefinitionAudit.mulHeight₁_eq_places`; for an algebraic integer the finite part is `1` and the infinite part is `∏_σ max 1 ‖σ x‖` (`DefinitionAudit.mulHeight₁_eq_prod_embeddings`).

sections.title: `NumberField.InfinitePlace.mult`
sections.comment: `1` at a real place, `2` at a complex place.

sections.title: `NumberField.Embeddings.card` (a theorem): the number of embeddings
sections.comment: The ring homomorphisms `L →+* ℂ` of statement 3 (and, in the uncompared theorems, the sums over `K →+* ℂ` in `T₂` and in the matrix `t2Gram` of a family in `K`) are exactly as many as the degree of the field (`DefinitionAudit.card_embeddings`: `[K:ℚ]` for `K`).

sections.title: `Polynomial.mahlerMeasure`
sections.comment: Used in statements 2 and 3, applied to `minpoly ℤ x` mapped to `ℂ[X]`. Kernel-checked: `DefinitionAudit.mahlerMeasure_X_sub_two` (`M(X − 2) = 2`) and `DefinitionAudit.mahlerMeasure_eq_lead_mul_prod_roots` (section 12).

sections.title: `Polynomial.mahlerMeasure_eq_leadingCoeff_mul_prod_roots` (a theorem)
sections.comment: The classical form `M(p) = |lead p| · ∏ max(1, |α|)` over the roots with multiplicity.

sections.title: `minpoly`
sections.comment: Statements 2 and 3 use `minpoly ℤ x` for `x ∈ 𝓞 L`, where it is monic (`DefinitionAudit.minpoly_monic_of_integer`); the junk value `0` (`DefinitionAudit.minpoly_eq_zero_of_not_isIntegral`) does not occur. The same holds for `minpoly ℤ (ρ * Q)`: `ρ` and `Q` are integral (`ρ_isIntegral_int`, `Q_isIntegral_int` in the carried block), hence so is `ρ * Q`.

sections.title: `Polynomial.aroots`
sections.comment: Used in `HeightT2.IsPerronNumber`: the complex roots, with multiplicity, of `minpoly ℤ r`.

sections.title: `IntermediateField.adjoin` (`ℚ⟮x⟯`)
sections.comment: `ℚ⟮x⟯` is notation for `adjoin ℚ {x}`; `ℚ⟮x⟯ = ⊤` says that `x` generates the field.

sections.title: `IntermediateField.LinearDisjoint`
sections.comment: Used by no compared statement: the hypothesis of the uncompared Gram identity `HeightT2.t2Gram_compositum` and the uncompared coordinate bound `HeightT2.coord_sq_le_sum_norm_sq` (HeightT2/Compositum.lean). Kernel-checked: `DefinitionAudit.linearDisjoint_bot` (satisfiable) and `DefinitionAudit.finrank_sup_of_linearDisjoint` (`[K₁ ⊔ K₂ : ℚ] = [K₁:ℚ][K₂:ℚ]`).

sections.title: The notation `⊗ₖ`
sections.comment: Used by no compared statement: it is the right side of the uncompared identity `HeightT2.t2Gram_compositum` (HeightT2/Compositum.lean), and it appears in `RulerSelection.Kron.kron_ge_diag`, which the proofs of the compared statements use (through `RulerSelection.LaneB.coord_sq_le`) and from which the uncompared coordinate bound is proved. Kernel-checked: `DefinitionAudit.kroneckerMap_mul_apply`.

sections.title: `Matrix.diagonal`
sections.comment: Used by no compared statement: the uncompared coordinate bound `HeightT2.coord_sq_le_sum_norm_sq` uses `diagonal (Pi.single i s)`, the matrix with `s` at `(i, i)` and `0` elsewhere.

sections.title: `Matrix.mulVec` (`*ᵥ`)
sections.comment: Used by no compared statement: the hypotheses `∀ v, 0 ≤ v ⬝ᵥ (M *ᵥ v)` of the uncompared coordinate bound `HeightT2.coord_sq_le_sum_norm_sq` say that the real matrix `M` is positive semidefinite as a quadratic form.

sections.title: `NumberField.Embeddings.pow_eq_one_of_norm_le_one` (a theorem; Kronecker 1857)
sections.comment: Prior art used, through `pow_eq_one_of_norm_eq_one`, in the proof of the equality case `HeightT2.sum_norm_sq_eq_mulHeight₁_sq_add_iff`, which is proved in the repository and not compared; not re-proved.
